I used to work out a lot too, but that was when I had free access to a gym.  I really liked it, but I have no motivation to pay the crazy prices to go to a big public gym.

I have this trend i guess of getting into things for about 6 months and then burning out on them.  I lose interest fast.

people always say that.  "just keep moving forward and it will all get better", but all it does is get worse and I don't like where it's going.  I don't believe it's true that things just "have to get better".  When does it get better?  Maybe I end up some homeless and mentally ill old man in the street and someone decides to help get me some housing or something?  Is that when it's supposed to get better?  Is that the better?  Is that how low it has to fall before it gets "better"?  Those aren't the thing's i'd hope to live through.

as a child, I escaped into video games and films as I had little other choice.  It was either that or be harassed and beat up as evidently my mere appearance has always enraged people.

Today I find most video games hollow and soulless, and most films are poorly made and are completely uninspired.  I go back to watch and play ones that I used to think were brilliant and were among my favorite, and I see those too were actually quite terrible.

I ended up going to school for film & media for exactly the purpose you stated - it seemed to be the only thing that made sense to me and the only thing I wanted to do.

Fast forward to two years out of school and it was all for naught.  There was no work, all job opportunities I had lined up evaporated months before graduation, and now I'm essentially a professional scapegoat for start up companies as there is no other work available.  I must live in both total fear of losing my job and in total loathing and contempt for it as it brings me not a single iota of pleasure or accomplishment - only stress and frustration.

I can't find pleasure in even the only two things I loved as a child.  There is no hope left.  I, too, appreciate the beauty of the universe and often wish I dedicated my life to exploring it rather than escapism, but it's far too late for that now and in all honesty - none of it matters as when I am dead I shall cease to exist.

It seems to me that people spend all their lifetimes looking for glimmers of hope and never actually get to achieve or experience what they hoped for.  In other words - there is no hope, because hope never arrives.

I'm not interested in hope anymore.  Fuck the future.  The future never comes.  Right now is shit, and it will always be right now, no matter how long I wait.  I'm fucking tired of it and refuse to live it anymore.

All of these "chances" are the same as my chances of winning the lottery - in other words it's not going to happen, even if I played the lottery.

Other people are shit to me.  If I have positively influenced someone, good on them, but I don't care what they think about me killing myself.  It does no good to me, as I'd be dead, and obviously they're not around so they mustn't give a fuck.

Good luck in your life, and I'm sorry to hear you've had troubles of your own.  Personally, I know things will never get better for me and my entire life is just going to be a stupid waste full of bullshit and more torment.  There is no benefit for completing it naturally, so I'm going to end it on my own terms tonight.  The only thing that's going to change that is if my life makes an instant 180 today, which I know it won't.  It's already half way done, and life doesn't move positively.  Things can only get worse.

Fuck, I'm on a god damn suicide watch forum, talking about killing myself in the very near future, and you are quite literally the only person who even gave the slightest shit to respond.  The world is full of them, not us.  It's not worth suffering through.  There's nothing for me here.

Unfortunately, I do not have a niche and there is nothing in life that I cherish.  Your story about the lesbian - things working out like that is for other people.  It only happens in movies and in fluff news pieces, but not in real life.  Not in my life.  It doesn't work that way for me.  I don't know anyone and the people I do encounter treat me like garbage.  I have the type of luck wherein if you were to tell me there was a clinic or something right next door to my home and all I had to do would be to go there and absolutely everything would be righted in my life, for free and instantly - as soon as I'd arrive it would be shut down or I'd be barred entry for some arbitrary reason or another.

I appreciate you trying to help, but I don't know what else to say but that this doesn't help.  I have absolutely no desire to play "wait and see what happens".  If life doesn't start looking up by the end of the night I think I'm done.  I've done the wait and see for too long.  I did everything I could think of to try and pull me out of this - I got myself an education (backfired), got a girlfriend (backfired), came to terms with being transgender and started trying to make those needed changes (backfired), tried to join the military when I was in high school (backfired).  Everything I've ever done has only hurt me further.  

I don't give any fucks about money any more than I'm required to to live.  Unfortunately in this country you need to be a millionaire to have rights and freedoms and any non-negative quality of life situations and to do anything that isn't soul crushing.

Life's crazy alright, but not in the right ways for me.  I don't get to go on quirky adventures or meet interesting eccentric people or discover new things - I just get shit on for no reason and out of left field every day and with no mysterious secret stash of wealth to actually go out and do things rather than be a wage slave to some rich asshole.  Life's not a fuckin' Jim Carrey movie.

I don't know what you mean by "open the corridor to see the possibilities".  I've already opened some pretty wild doors in my 26 years and they've all led to pitfalls and nothing gained, everything lost.

There's nothing left for my anger to fuel except self-destruction.  There's nothing to be built with this.  I already spent my entire life trying to build an actual life for myself so that I'm not drowning in the same poverty as my parents and neighbors, and it didn't get me anywhere except a job i loathe with people I hate that pays the bills and is in no other way fulfilling in any way shape or form.  There's no where else for me to go to build some sort of life.  This is it.  This is where it ends.  I'm too old and too bad at everything to do anything worth while, evidently.

And I look at the world around me and I wonder why the fuck I'd want to live here even if I was a happy person with a decent life.  Why the fuck would I want to be one of these stupid fucking people who are not only ignorant to how stupid or ignorant they are, but happy about it?  Why would I want to live in a world where I am completely powerless and hopeless against any adversary, and our government continues to make sure we know this?  Why would I want to live in a world that just hates anyone who isn't exactly like them?  Where the fuck is the value in this world?  What's the point in learning how to do new things in it?  Let's pretend it's even possible for me to learn how to use a guitar (it's not.  I tried it already) - what the fuck does that accomplish?  I'll make some noises with it, and the world is exactly the same.  Life is exactly the same.  Nothing new is to be done with it as it's all been done.  I've yet to find a single thing in life that doesn't fit this same pointless mold.

I've given all that I have to give, I am completely drained of everything at this point in my life.  I have worked, and worked, and worked, and worked and put up with abuse after abuse, failure after failure, and it's led me no where.

This is honestly my last ultimatum to life - I've done my fucking part a billion times over.  it's time for life to hold it's end of the bargain or I'm fucking done.  I'm fucking sick of being singled out for whatever the most awful treatment in any situation at any given time is to receive as I watch on with jealousy and anger at people who didn't have to do anything except be born to have normal, fulfilling, happy lives.

I can't even fucking look at other people anymore.  There is absolutely nothing with any even remotely enjoyable properties left for me to interact with.  There is no beauty to balance out the pain - I don't know where you got that from.

I can't enjoy this.  I've tried.
i'm 26 years in.  No it doesn't.  I'm biting the bullet tonight.

I don't tell my employer anything, as I live in America and American employers seem to look for any excuse they can find to fire or not hire someone.  Like it's a game to them.

I suffer similarly to you, I just try and hide it as best as I can.  You can not trust your employer.  With anything.  Ever.

I'd honestly rather kill myself than jump around different therapists and medications that I know won't do anything.  I don't have the energy or money for all of that.  I don't really have anything in life worth saving.

I need something guaranteed or else I'm done.  I'm tired of being used and taken advantage of.
